crossRefs.note: Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.
They came on me in the day of my calamity, but Yahweh was my support.
And by this we know that we are of the truth, and persuade our hearts before him,

translations.web: This is my way, that I keep your precepts.
translations.bsb: This is my practice, for I obey Your precepts.
translations.kjv: This I had, because I kept thy precepts.
translations.asv: This I have had, Because I have kept thy precepts.
